overview.text: Today's key developments highlight major releases and architectural advancements across the artificial intelligence landscape. DeepSeek has open-sourced its inference engine, providing the community with valuable implementation details to improve custom engines. In probabilistic forecasting, Mistral AI introduced Timestral in four sizes ranging from 5M to 209M parameters, offering CPU-efficient and zero-shot capabilities. Mistral also launched Voxtral 3, a voice agent SDK delivering real-time speech processing across more than 50 languages. Meanwhile, new model releases continue to expand multimodal and creative capabilities, featuring Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, Lightricks/LTX-2.5, and facebook/sam3. In research, new benchmarks and methodologies such as OR-License and OpenVLHarness are evaluating LLM and multimodal agents on complex, real-world tasks. Finally, industry analyses examine the rapid proliferation of decision models for evals and project significant infrastructure growth with datacenters anticipating major expansion by the year 2027.

entries.title: DeepSeek just open-sourced its inference engine
entries.summary: This is crazy good for studying to improve existing custom engines by community like gufo, halogen, strixite, Strata... by learning their secret sauces.
entries.why: Provides the community with valuable implementation details to study and improve custom inference engines.

entries.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
entries.summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation?
entries.why: Evaluates whether language model agents can deliver expert-level operations research solutions directly from clients.

entries.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
entries.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the…
entries.why: Studies multimodal agents using visual tool-use and memory across multiple benchmarks.

entries.title: Introducing Timestral
entries.summary: State-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in four sizes (5M–209M params), CPU-efficient, zero-shot ready.
entries.why: Delivers state-of-the-art probabilistic forecasting in four sizes with CPU-efficient and zero-shot readiness.

entries.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
entries.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment.
entries.why: Examines how policy models and interaction harnesses jointly determine coding agent performance.

entries.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
entries.summary: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model.
entries.why: Explores world model generalization beyond expert rollouts for planning and simulating actions.

entries.title: BlenderWorld: Benchmarking Visual Agents for 3D Creation from Real-World References
entries.summary: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have enabled them to act as autonomous agents, creating and editing 3D models via code or direct software manipulation.
entries.why: Benchmarks multimodal agents acting autonomously to create and edit 3D models via code or software.

entries.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
entries.why: Offers a new image-text-to-text transformer model with high download activity on Hugging Face.

entries.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
entries.why: Provides an image-to-video diffusion model for generative video tasks.

entries.title: facebook/sam3
entries.why: Delivers a new mask-generation transformer model for computer vision applications.

entries.title: Voxtral 3
entries.summary: Voxtral 3: Mistral's voice agent SDK for real-time speech in 50+ languages — accurate transcription, emotional TTS, deep tool use. EU-hosted or self-deployed.
entries.why: Provides a voice agent SDK for real-time speech with emotional TTS and deep tool use.

entries.title: How Claude designed protein binders against scorpion neurotoxins
entries.summary: We asked an internal research Claude model to design minibinders (small proteins that attach tightly to a target) against scorpion neurotoxins.
entries.why: Demonstrates how an internal research model designed minibinders against scorpion neurotoxins.

entries.title: 30 Months on the Exponential (in Charts)
entries.summary: My new book is out today... what happened since the last one
entries.why: Explores thirty months of exponential technological progress through charts and analysis.

entries.title: How To Use Decision Models for Evals
entries.summary: Decision models have exploded onto the scene recently, starting with TypeSafe’s Jev, followed by Perplexity’s Decider, Liquid’s d1, Cloudflare’s Clef, and OpenAI’s Decisions API1. These models promise fast, inexpensive classification.
entries.why: Examines the explosive emergence of fast and inexpensive decision models for evaluations.

entries.title: Datacenters 2027: The Year of Acceleration, +50GW in a Single Year
entries.summary: 60GW Under Construction, SemiAnalysis Leading Indicators, 1.3T of Lease Contracts Signed YTD, The Shortage Could Move to Chips
entries.why: Analyzes datacenter acceleration trends, lease contracts, and capacity projections leading up to 2027.
